decisions.reason: As the flagship organic line with several models aligned to the firm's strategic direction, its option value remains high and there is still no evidence that its value is unlikely, so it is kept open at very low cost.

The organic poultry mini snack remains a low-cost option in a growing organic segment but its niche positioning and two years on the market raise some uncertainty, so a moderate probability of dropping is assigned while keeping it open.

The premium sharing salami snack is close to the established offer and has several models, but its premium niche may face cost pressure, so it is kept with a slightly higher chance of being pruned if value does not materialize.

The organic boiled pork sausage is a recent launch with its own page and builds on the firm's established processing capabilities, so early uncertainty still favors keeping the option open at low cost.
The organic thinly sliced chicken breast line with several variants aligns with the organic direction and is still new, so its unresolved upside and low keeping cost justify keeping it open.
The organic herb-coated salami is a close extension and recent launch with its own page, and while its differentiation may be limited, it is still early enough to keep as a low-cost option.
